description: This file implements a server-side RPC interface for hijacking HTTP responses, including methods for reading, writing, closing, and setting deadlines on hijacked connections, as well as client-side code to initiate hijacking.

classes.name: hijackedConn
classes.description: Represents a hijacked network connection with methods for reading, writing, closing, and setting deadlines.

classes.name: hijackedConnRW
classes.description: Wraps an RPC client for reading and writing over a hijacked connection.

classes.name: httpResponseWriterRPCClient
classes.description: Client for RPC calls to hijack HTTP responses.

methods.name: HjConnRWRead
methods.description: Reads data from a hijacked connection via RPC.

methods.name: HjConnRWWrite
methods.description: Writes data to a hijacked connection via RPC.

methods.name: HjConnRead
methods.description: Reads data from a hijacked connection via RPC.

methods.name: HjConnWrite
methods.description: Writes data to a hijacked connection via RPC.

methods.name: HjConnClose
methods.description: Closes a hijacked connection via RPC.

methods.name: HjConnSetDeadline
methods.description: Sets deadline for a hijacked connection via RPC.

methods.name: HjConnSetReadDeadline
methods.description: Sets read deadline for a hijacked connection via RPC.

methods.name: HjConnSetWriteDeadline
methods.description: Sets write deadline for a hijacked connection via RPC.

methods.name: HijackResponse
methods.description: Performs hijacking of an HTTP response, establishing a connection for further control.

methods.name: Hijack
methods.description: Client method to initiate hijacking of an HTTP response, returning a net.Conn and bufio.ReadWriter.
